title: Silverleaf Hollow: the elven wood
about: An elven hollow laid out to show the elven tile set and its people: a moonstone court round a moonwell with lanterns at its corners, the elven hall and a white spire to the north, flets high in the great trees, mallorns on drifts of fallen gold leaves, silver willows over a moonlit pool, and moss starred with moonflowers. The elf lady, the sage, the warden and the ranger keep the court; two dark elves creep in from the western wood. Walk the elf lady about with the arrow keys or by clicking; Space talks to whoever is in front.
